text: Welcome to Halloween Park! Let’s play hide-and-seek!
The pirate is hiding. Let’s find him!
Where is the pirate?
Look around the park. Can you see him?
Take another look. Where is the pirate?
You found me! I’m under the swing!
Hello, Stephanie!
Stephanie, can you help me find the mermaid?
Where is the mermaid?
Look around. Can you see her tail?
Take another look. Where is the mermaid?
Yes! The mermaid is in the sea!
Hi, Stephanie!
Can you help me find my vampire ring?
It has red eyes and bat wings!
Where is my vampire ring?
Can you find it, Stephanie?
Look around the park. Can you see the red eyes?
Look carefully. Where is my vampire ring?
You found me! Thank you, Stephanie!
I was on the bench!
Now let’s find my ship!
Let’s look around!
Where is my ship?
Look at the blue water. On the sea!
Let’s look on the sea!
There’s my ship!
Let’s take my vampire ring to the ship!
All aboard! Let’s go!
You found the pirate, the mermaid, the vampire ring, and the ship!
Thank you, Stephanie! I’m happy!
Hooray! You’re a great treasure finder!
You did it! You got a Pirate sticker!
Bye-bye, Stephanie!
Bye-bye! See you soon!
